rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the status or benefits of belonging to an organization.

example.english: My gym membership is about to expire.
example.traditional: 我個健身會籍就嚟到期喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 gin6 san1 wui6 zik6 zau6 lai4 dou3 kei4 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the complete body or collective group of members.

example.english: The entire membership has to attend tonight’s annual meeting.
example.traditional: 全體會員都要出席今晚嘅周年大會。
example.jyutping: cyun4 tai2 wui6 jyun4 dou1 jiu3 ceot1 zik6 gam1 maan1 ge3 zau1 nin4 daai6 wui6
